My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
KAI • AI ASSISTANT
I’m sorry your item arrived damaged.
According to Naked Wardrobe’s policy, if your item is defective, damaged, or incorrect, you should initiate an EXCHANGE REQUEST THROUGH THE RETURN PORTAL and select the appropriate return reason. You’ll be asked to provide:
- a brief description of the issue
- a photo of the item
- a photo of the care tag located inside the garment
If your request is approved, their team will email you a PREPAID LABEL.
I also found that items received damaged or incorrect are eligible for an EXCHANGE, and they can only exchange for the SAME STYLE.
